Nullgram is independently modified from Niagram (formerly NiagramX), revision bc99e5e9907a2ea47d9e6ed432469b8ff553644f. Modified 2026-11-01. It is not an official release of Niagram, NagramX, Nagram, Nekogram or Telegram. Copyright and third-party notices are preserved. Source is licensed under GPLv3; matching complete source and build instructions accompany the APK distribution. The application ID is retained for compatibility; the Nullgram display name identifies this independent fork; launcher artwork retains its original attribution, with optional independent Nullgram icons. The watchlist belongs to this page’s account. New options are off by default. People are identified by user ID, never by names, channel signatures or forwarded authors. Channel comments count as group messages. Channel posts need an explicit personal sender ID. Online alerts use visible status only, skip initial/reconnect baselines and have a 60-second cooldown. Privacy, network and background restrictions can cause missed alerts.
